introduction: I work where financial analysis and technology meet: understanding how a number is produced, investigating discrepancies and tracing issues through the systems behind it.
evidence: My background spans systematic investment operations at Man Group, commodity pricing at Louis Dreyfus Company and production application support. Alongside those roles, I designed, built and continue to run Neutron.bg, a live Django e-commerce platform.

highlights.text: Systematic trading fund experience at Man Group
Senior Pricing Middle Officer at Louis Dreyfus Company
Master's in E-Management, graduated with Honours
